data.name: SubTitle
data.value: Web developer, programmer, web designer, and SEO specialist. I create fast, accessible websites, games, and apps.

data.name: AboutMeP1
data.value: My name is Jan Sebastián Kostlán, and I focus primarily on web development, programming, web design, and SEO. I enjoy finding the connection between technical solutions and real-world results. I create fast, accessible, and secure websites, develop games and apps, and manage online marketing to ensure projects aren't just good-looking, but also visible and effective.

data.name: AboutMeP2
data.value: In practice, I work with .NET/ASP.NET Core and modern frontend technologies. I enjoy automating deployments using Docker and CI/CD, and ensuring quality—from Core Web Vitals to accessibility. Thanks to my experience with SEO and data analysis, I can design website content and structure for the best search engine performance.

data.name: AboutMeP3
data.value: I also have specific areas of interest that I actively pursue. Chief among these is game development in Unity—from small prototypes to multiplayer projects. I care about clean architecture, great user experience, and ensuring that every app or game has measurable value.

data.name: AboutMeP4
data.value: In my free time, I focus on fitness and strength training, which helps me balance computer work and motivates me to push my boundaries. Just like in IT, I enjoy tracking my progress in sports and finding ways to be one step further every day.

data.name: AboutMeP5
data.value: My goal is to leave a mark in every field I enjoy—from websites and apps, to games and SEO, to personal growth. I want to build things that hold long-term value and prove that the combination of technology, creativity, and perseverance can push boundaries.

data.name: AboutMeP6
data.value: Want to see what I'm working on right now? Check out my projects or read my blog. If you're interested in collaborating on a website, game, or need SEO consultation, reach out via contact. I'd love to discuss your idea and propose a solution.
